2607.22047.title: Multiplicity of Stable Attractors in Disordered Neural Models
2607.22047.paper_summary: We show how large-deviation statistics allows one to obtain reliable estimates of the multiplicity of stable fixed-points in a model of neural ordinary differential equations previously employed in computational tasks. The result is obtained by developing a suitable perturbative method in the amplitude of the disorder. It turns out that for not-too-large coupling strengths there are no qualitative differences between the symmetric case, when the dynamics is a purely gradient evolution, and the asymmetric case, when limit cycles and chaos can, in principle, arise. The selection of this specific model is dictated by pedagogical reasons, but we are confident that the approach can be extended to other many-degree-of-freedom dynamical models characterized by different classes of random coupling matrices.
2607.22047.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了大偏差統計如何使人們能夠獲得在先前用於計算任務的神經常微分方程模型中穩定固定點的多重性可靠估計。這一結果是通過發展一種適合的擾動方法來獲得的，該方法是針對擾動的幅度。事實證明，對於不是太大的耦合強度，對稱情況（當動力學是純粹的梯度演化時）和非對稱情況（當極限週期和混沌在原則上可以出現時）之間沒有質的區別。選擇這個特定模型是出於教學原因，但我們相信這種方法可以擴展到其他由不同類別的隨機耦合矩陣特徵的多自由度動力學模型。
